policy.execution_model: All-cash spot long/flat; previous closed-bar decision, next open; terminal liquidation explicitly tagged; no leverage.
policy.warmup_policy: 82 days before evaluation, requiring a synchronizing MR40 threshold before the first evaluated decision and a full 180-bar momentum history. Gate and cash reset at evaluation boundary, matching the Bybit fresh-account study.
policy.window_policy: Same 180 closed bars as the latest Bybit study; fixed before LBank history acquisition. No window or parameter search.
